I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-random to confirm that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats. I said I'd use that figure instead of the one in her #north-team post this morning.

I didn't take any other action, since she said none was needed. I didn't edit or reply to her #north-team post, and I didn't repeat that figure. Her original post there still shows the old number, so people in #north-team won't see the fix unless she posts it there herself.
